maddeler.e:
ابتعثن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثْنَ (ibtaʕaṯna) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثْنَ (ubtuʕiṯna) /ub.tu.ʕiθ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعِثْنَ (ibtaʕiṯna) /ib.ta.ʕiθ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
